title: Discrete Compositional Generation via General Soft Operators and Robust Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2506.17007v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A major bottleneck in scientific discovery consists of narrowing an exponentially large set of objects, such as proteins or molecules, to a small set of promising candidates with desirable properties. While this process can rely on expert knowledge, recent methods leverage reinforcement learning (RL) guided by a proxy reward function to enable this filtering. By employing various forms of entropy regularization, these methods aim to learn samplers that generate diverse candidates that are highly rated by the proxy function. In this work, we make two main contributions. First, we show that these methods are liable to generate overly diverse, suboptimal candidates in large search spaces. To address this issue, we introduce a novel unified operator that combines several regularized RL operators into a general framework that better targets peakier sampling distributions. Secondly, we offer a novel, robust RL perspective of this filtering

translated_title: 基于广义软算子与鲁棒强化学习的离散组合生成
translated_abstract: 科学发现的一个主要瓶颈在于如何将指数级庞大的对象集合（如蛋白质或分子）缩小为具有理想性质的少量有前景的候选对象。虽然这一过程可以依赖专家知识，但近年来的方法利用由代理奖励函数引导的强化学习（RL）来实现这种筛选。通过采用各种形式的熵正则化，这些方法旨在学习能够生成多样候选对象的采样器，且这些候选对象在代理函数中获得高评分。在这项工作中，我们做出了两个主要贡献。首先，我们证明这些方法在大型搜索空间中容易生成过度多样且次优的候选对象。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的统一算子，将多个正则化RL算子结合到一个通用框架中，能够更好地瞄准更尖锐（更集中）的采样分布。其次，我们为这种筛选过程提供了一个新颖且鲁棒的强化学习视角。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种将多个正则化RL算子统一起来的广义软算子框架以及鲁棒强化学习视角，解决了现有熵正则化方法在大型搜索空间中生成过度多样、次优候选对象的问题，从而更有效地筛选出具有理想性质的蛋白质或分子等候选对象。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified general soft operator framework combining multiple regularized RL operators, along with a novel robust RL perspective, addressing the problem that existing entropy-regularized methods tend to generate overly diverse, suboptimal candidates in large search spaces, thereby enabling more effective filtering of promising candidates such as proteins or molecules with desirable properties.
